title: Raid the Emerald Grove
html:
Raid the Grove is a sub-quest of the Druid Grove's main quest ⁠Save the Refugees. It can be initiated by talking to  Minthara in the Shattered Sanctum within the Goblin Camp and telling her the location of the grove.

Objectives

Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes.

Speak with Minthara.
  • "Dror Ragzlin told us to speak to the drow Minthara. She plans to raid the adventurers' refuge - the grove."
Interrogate the prisoner.
  • "Minthara asked us to interrogate the prisoner. She wants to know where the adventurers were hiding out."
Speak with Minthara.
  • "The adventurer gave in and revealed the location of the grove. We have what the drow Minthara needs to order the raid."
Prepare to raid the Grove.
  • "Minthara is preparing to attack the grove and told us to wait for next light. We should get some rest."
  • "Sazza told the drow Minthara where the grove is. Minthara plans to raid it - and wants our help."
Secure the Emerald Grove.
  • "Minthara and her warband have set out for the Grove. They are waiting for us to infiltrate it."
Report to the tiefling leader.
  • "We arrived at the grove just in time. Minthara's raiders will be here soon."
Blow the horn.
  • "The tieflings are as ready as they can be. All that's left is to sound the horn."
Defeat the raiders.
  • "Minthara arrived with raiders by her side. Defeating them means safety at last for the tieflings."
Return to Zevlor/Asharak/Cerys.
  • "The goblins were beaten back, and the tieflings lived to tell the tale. Zevlor/Asharak/Cerys wants to talk."
Slaughter the Emerald Grove.
  • "We chose Minthara and the Absolute over the tieflings. Now to take the grove."
  • "The tieflings are dead, but the druids are making a last stand at their sacred pool."
Return to Minthara.
  • "Tieflings and druids alike lie dead. The grove belongs to the Absolute. Minthara will be pleased."
  • "The grove was overrun before we could get involved. We should speak to Minthara."
  • "Faced with a barricade of vines, the goblins couldn't raid the grove. Minthara isn't happy."
Quest Complete
  • "The goblin threat has ended, and the tieflings are ready to leave. Tonight, we celebrate our victory at camp."
  • "With the tieflings dead, the grove is ours. Pleased, the Absolute granted us new powers. Tonight we celebrate at camp."
  • "Minthara was furious that the grove was sealed and attacked us."
  • "Minthara died before she could lead an attack on the grove."
  • "Minthara died before she could reward us for our part in the attack on the grove."

Walkthrough

This topic has a community guide.

Raiding the Emerald Grove can be started either by talking to  Minthara in the Shattered Sanctum alone, or by completing ⁠Save the Goblin Sazza and accompanying  Sazza to inform Minthara about the Grove. Once the goblin forces are aware of the Grove's location, they mobilize to raid it. Minthara bids the party go back to the Grove and infiltrate it from within. The raid occurs after the next Long Rest.

Once back at the Grove, the druids and tieflings have moved in response to the goblin's movements. The druids lock themselves into the Inner Sanctum and refuse to shelter any outlanders.[1]  Rikka gathers the tiefling children, starting ⁠Find Doni if the party agrees to help her.

To start the raid, a party member must speak to  Zevlor on the ramparts at X: 192 Y: 446 It is possible to tell him the party betrayed the tieflings, starting the battle early, or speak with him further for more information on his strategy. If Zevlor believes the party members are on his side, he instructs them to sound the war horn once they are ready to start the raid. Immediately after sounding the horn the goblins appear, as well as Minthara, who orders the player character to open the gate.

The player characted can obey:

[2]
  • Obey and open the gate.
  • [EVIL CLERIC] [EVIL PALADIN] Of course - as does my god.
  • [OATHBREAKER] They still think I'm on their side. Poor fools.

The player character can also refuse instead:

[2]
  • No. This grove is under my protection.
  • I serve Shar, not the Absolute. The gate stays closed. (Shadowheart only)
  • [CLERIC] Your god has no power here.
  • New plan - I tear out your throat. (Astarion only)
  • There's been a change of plan. (Lae'zel only)
  • I will not. Boo will not. And if you think to triumph here today, drow - you will not. (Minsc only) (impossible without mods)
  • Not so fast. You've just walked into my trap. (Wyll only)
  • These people are under my protection - but I'll see you in the Hells. (Karlach only)
  • [GOOD CLERIC] [NEUTRAL CLERIC] [GOOD PALADIN] [NEUTRAL PALADIN] No. I'll show the Absolute the power of a true god.
  • [DRUID] This place is sacred to Silvanus - the Absolute has no power here.
  • [PALADIN] I will not bring death to this sacred place, Minthara. (Non-Oathbreaker only)

If the party opens the gate, Minthara and the Goblin raiders become allies while the tieflings and Wyll (if present) become enemies. The party must, together with Minthara and the goblins, move through the grove in sections clearing out all that remain. On returning to Minthara after the battle she tells the player character she will meet them at camp for the victory celebration with the goblins. There Minthara congratulates the player character and rewards them with a gift from the Absolute - a True Soul tadpole. After the night ends, Minthara tells the player character that they must go to Moonrise Towers to find their place in the Absolute's Grand Design. She provides a  Spider's Lyre and explains that a servant of hers can lead the party through the Shadow-Cursed Lands where Moonrise Towers is located. This instrument can also be pickpocketed from her, which results in a second instrument being generated should she later be recruited as a companion. Then, she leaves, stating that she is gathering the troops to meet the party at Moonrise Towers. This starts ⁠Travel to Moonrise Towers.

Refusing her instructions and protecting the grove results in the tieflings acting as allies. After the battle the surviving tieflings speak to the player character and thank them for their help, then celebrate at camp. If  Halsin is alive, he appears to congratulate the player character and explains the strange movements occurring at Moonrise Towers. He tells them that the best shot at curing their tadpoles is going there, and offers to go with them.

Consequences

Raiding the grove

Choosing to raid the grove with the goblin forces has immense, far-reaching consequences for the game, some of which can only be felt in later Acts. These consequences include:

  •  Karlach and  Wyll leave the party (or cannot be recruited if they have not already been).
  •  Halsin is not available as a companion.
  •  Gale leaves the party unless an Insight or Deception check is passed.
  • ⁠Lift the Shadow Curse cannot be undertaken in Act Two.
  • Loss of many rare equipment items, as the traders  Dammon and  Mattis cannot be traded with in Acts Two and Three.
  • Halsin,  Arabella, Dammon, and  Zevlor cannot be recruited for ⁠Gather Your Allies.
  •  Rolan cannot be recruited for ⁠Gather Your Allies if he was convinced to stay and defend the Grove earlier.
  • All unfinished quests involving the Grove cannot be successfully completed.
  • The inspiration ⁠Slaughter's Prize is granted to party members with the Criminal background.
  • The inspiration ⁠Camaraderie in Bloodthirst is granted to the  Dark Urge.

Siding with the tieflings and druids and defending the grove

  • Choosing to bring the goblins to the Emerald Grove, but then siding with the tieflings and druids lets the story play out similarly to as if the party had defeated the goblin camp leaders, but without the need to defeat the other two leaders  Gut and  Dror Ragzlin. However, some of the tieflings might die in the fight.
  • Siding with the Emerald Grove also results in  Minthara being available as a companion in Act Two, if she is not killed but  Knocked Out instead.
  • Many but not all goblins who accompany Minthara on the raid can be encountered only during the raid.
  • If the party returns, the entire Goblin Camp is hostile to them.

Not participating in the fight at the grove

A somewhat different set of consequences is incurred if the party chooses to leave the region without participating in the fight at the grove, including:

  • All tieflings of the Emerald Grove die.
  • Karlach and Wyll stay in the party (or can still be recruited if Act Two has not been started yet by travelling to the Shadow-Cursed Lands).
  • Karlach's Infernal Engine cannot be repaired because Dammon dies.
  • Halsin cannot be recruited as companion, and spontaneously dies in his last known location, even if previously saved from the Goblins.
  • Gale permanently leaves the party.
  • The quest ⁠Lift the Shadow Curse, if started, cannot be successfully completed.
  • Loss of many rare equipment items, as the then dead traders Dammon and Mattis will not be present in Acts Two or Three.
  • Halsin, Arabella, Dammon, and Zevlor cannot be recruited for ⁠Gather Your Allies.
  • Rolan cannot be recruited for ⁠Gather Your Allies if he was convinced to stay and defend the Grove earlier.
  • All unfinished quests involving the Emerald Grove cannot be successfully completed.
  • Despite refusing Minthara's orders, she is still available as a potential companion in Act Two.
  • A specific bit of dialogue happens with the being in the  Astral Prism, but all other characters appear to ignore the decision.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Should the tieflings and druids have fought previously, the sanctum remains both open and empty. In this event Rath and Silver relocate to the front of the stone door leading to the secluded chamber.
  2. ↑ 2.0 2.1 Dialogue file: Act1/DEN/DEN_AttackOnDen_RaidersArriveBeforeFight
  3. ↑ Before patch 5 this method also required polymorphing her into a sheep, and transporting her to Moonrise manually.
